name: Haiku global diversification via US-listed ADRs and ETFs
strategy: Diversify beyond concentrated leveraged semis/tech toward emerging markets theme (+25.2% YTD outperformance) with crypto, broad US market, international equities, and bond ballast at elevated yields.
reassessment_note: Current book worked well (+3.32% vs SPY +3.00%) but is overconcentrated in leveraged 3x semis (SOXL, TQQQ) showing exhaustion signals (Aroon downtrend Sept 15, AI skepticism). Broad EM up 25.2% YTD vs 12% for SPY—this is 2026's dominant theme that book underweights. BTC remains strong (+31.74%) but single-position crypto concentration is risky. Current 62.8% cash is defensive but reactive. Reposition to capture EM outperformance, reduce leverage risk, add diversification via VXUS (14.29% YTD), broad VTI, and TLT bond ballast at 5.17% 10Y yield. Lock in leveraged gains by reducing SOXL/TQQQ positions.

positions.thesis: Broad emerging markets (EM +25.2% YTD vs SPY +12%) is 2026's clear outperformer, driven by valuation recovery and US-China trade talks progress. IEMG provides core EM exposure with 22.49% YTD return and $160.9B in assets. Upgrade from 9.76% to 20% to capture dominant trend. Stop at 15% to protect against China/EM recession fears; take-profit at 25% to lock gains.

Bitcoin momentum remains strong (+31.74% YTD from entry) on regulatory clarity and macro shift to alternative assets. Crypto positioning from current book continues to work. Slight increase from 12.2% to 14% to emphasize asset class strength. Stop at 25% guards against macro risk-off; take-profit at 40% captures further upside.

Vanguard Total Stock Market ETF provides foundational US broad-market exposure capturing mega-cap AI infrastructure beneficiaries (NVIDIA 6.87%, Apple 6.30%, Microsoft 5.10%) with 0.03% expense ratio. Core holding for stability and diversification vs concentrated semis. No stop/TP for foundation position.

Japan regional diversification with demonstrated stability (+6.00% YTD from entry, +3.26% in current Round 3 position). Maintain allocation for persistent low-volatility diversification and Japan's relative outperformance. No stop/TP given steady performance.

Vanguard Total International Stock Index captures developed and emerging markets ex-US (14.29% YTD) with low 0.05% expense ratio and $665.69B in assets. Complements IEMG EM focus with international developed exposure. No stop/TP for stable diversification holding.

iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF provides ballast at elevated 5.17% 10-year and 5.27% 30-year yields (highest since 2004-2007). Harvests bond income while offering portfolio stability and negative correlation to equities during risk-off. Positioned for income and diversification. No stop/TP for defensive allocation.

Reduce from 1.22% to lock in +32.10% YTD gains on Direxion 3x leveraged semiconductor exposure. Maintain minimal 1% position as hedge to semis recovery while eliminating concentrated leverage risk. Aroon downtrend signal (Sept 15) and AI skepticism building warrant reduction. Stop at 20% captures portfolio mean reversion protection; take-profit at 40% captures further upside.

ProShares UltraPro QQQ 3x Nasdaq leverage reduced from 1.22% to 0.5% to lock in +23.42% YTD gains and eliminate concentrated tech leverage risk. Maintain tiny 0.5% position as asymmetric upside hedge with smaller downside exposure. Stop at 15% protects against tech washout; take-profit at 30% harvests remaining gains.
